title: The iPhone reads the shared alcohol question words
evidence: packages/health-core/src/alcohol-question-words.ts holds the Dismiss question's words (US-60 AC6). ios/HealthRoadmap/Plan/PlanCardView.swift AlcoholQuestion keeps its own copy: its unanswered line says 'You can change it in Settings, under About you.' and stillDrinks always names About you. Remedy with the next app build: read the shared copy (one wording, 'You can change it in About you.'). Until then alcohol-question-words.test.ts checks the Swift copy holds the two titles and the drinker line
